title: Systematic discovery of directional regulatory motifs associated with human insulator sites
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习系统发现与人类绝缘子位点相关的方向性调控基序，聚焦CTCF等DNA结合蛋白的基序识别与方向性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和AI方法，但未深入三维互作建模或结合机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Insulator proteins function as barriers to enhancer–promoter interactions (EPIs), thereby regulating gene expression. The primary insulator protein in vertebrates is CTCF, a DNA-binding protein (DBP); however, the roles of other DBPs in EPI insulation are not fully understood. To address this, we developed a systematic and comprehensive deep learning–based approach to identify DNA motifs of DBPs associated with insulator function. Applying this method to human fibroblast cells, we identified 97 directional motifs and a smaller number of non-directional motifs. These motifs were mapped to 23 DBPs previously linked to insulator activity, CTCF, and/or other forms of chromosomal transcriptional regulation. We found that the estimated orientation bias of CTCF was consistently proportional to the orientation bias observed in chromatin interaction data. Furthermore, these motifs showed significant enrichment at insulator sites that separate repressive and active chromatin regions, at chromatin interaction–defined boundaries, and at splice sites, compared to motifs of other DBPs. For instance, we observed that the key regulator MyoD-binding site is located at an insulator site near a gene involved in skeletal muscle differentiation and function. Importantly, our findings support the previously proposed insulator-pairing model, which suggests that insulator–insulator interactions are orientation-dependent, and highlight the involvement of multiple DNA-binding proteins beyond CTCF. Together, these results provide new insights into transcriptional regulatory mechanisms mediated by insulator-associated DBPs.
abstract_zh: 绝缘体蛋白作为增强子-启动子相互作用（EPIs）的屏障，从而调控基因表达。脊椎动物中主要的绝缘体蛋白是CTCF，一种DNA结合蛋白（DBP）；然而，其他DBP在EPI绝缘中的作用尚未完全明了。为解决此问题，我们开发了一种系统且全面的基于深度学习的方法，以识别与绝缘体功能相关的DBP的DNA基序。将此方法应用于人类成纤维细胞，我们识别出97个方向性基序和较少数量的非方向性基序。这些基序被映射到23个先前与绝缘体活性、CTCF和/或其他形式的染色体转录调控相关的DBP上。我们发现，CTCF的估计方向偏倚与染色质相互作用数据中观察到的方向偏倚始终成比例。此外，与其它DBP的基序相比，这些基序在分隔抑制性和活性染色质区域的绝缘位点、染色质相互作用定义的边界以及剪接位点处显著富集。例如，我们观察到关键调控因子MyoD结合位点位于骨骼肌分化和功能相关基因附近的绝缘位点。重要的是，我们的发现支持先前提出的绝缘体配对模型，该模型表明绝缘体-绝缘体相互作用具有方向依赖性，并强调了除CTCF外多种DNA结合蛋白的参与。综合来看，这些结果为绝缘体相关DBP介导的转录调控机制提供了新见解。
